posts.title: Burnt lake to Ramona loop
posts.description: Did a really good run over the weekend from Ramona falls up to Burnt lake and over Timberline and Paradise park, then back down to Ramona falls. It was a cold and rainy day but felt great. If you start at the Ramona falls TH, you can backtrack on the road up the hill to the Burnt lake trail. posts.title: Local Cow
posts.description: We found a new burger place in Gresham that we really like. Local Cow is a wonderful place in downtown Gresham that serves up a variety of burgers sourced locally. It has a great college-town vibe with friendly staff and quick service. A great stop when returning from a trip up to Mt. Hood. Local Cow1 336 North Main Avenue Gresham, Oregon 97030
